The m116 pair is a deliberately local response experiment anchored by two measured endpoints with an already confirmed reversed solvent trend. m130 provides two condition points against a measured early baseline to test an extreme model branch. m173, m117, and m159 add solvent-response labels where measured behavior is broad, irregular, or endpoint-specific. The remaining m212, m119, and m104 rows cover underrepresented basic, donor-containing, and amino-aromatic environments. Together these labels should improve endpoint calibration, interval-width learning, molecular-condition interactions, and transfer across repeated Row-distribution families rather than concentrating only on predicted late elution."}
